fix: grok assimilate auto-creates polyseme for all GitHub URLs — should only create when name is ambiguous
tasks.description: The assimilate_github_repo function in grok.rs unconditionally creates a .polyseme.tomllmd for every GitHub URL. This is wrong — a polyseme should only be created when a name genuinely resolves to multiple conflicting artifacts (e.g. bubblewrap = sandbox tool vs Android app). For unambiguous repos like Unlimited-OCR, create a regular CLI datum scaffold instead.

tasks.title: gap: grok assimilate create .cli.toml stub for unambiguous repos
tasks.description: grok assimilate creates .datum.toml (knowledge blob) + .polyseme.tomllmd (wrong for single-meaning repos). For unambiguous repos: auto-create .cli.toml stub with install/update/detect filled from repo metadata (language, build system, binary name). Only create polyseme when name collision is detected. File: b00t-cli/src/commands/grok.rs assimilate_github_repo()
acceptance_criteria: .cli.toml created for single-meaning repos; polyseme only for ambiguous names

tasks.title: gap: Boot command install should use datum dispatch not hardcoded opencode_install_mcp
tasks.description: Boot validates target via datum existence (good), but install still calls opencode_install_mcp directly. File: b00t-cli/src/commands/mcp.rs handle_boot()
acceptance_criteria: Boot works for any agent with a .cli.toml datum
